rules.title: SMART discovery metadata
rules.description: Verifies required authorization, token, and capability discovery fields.
rules.remediation: Publish complete SMART configuration from the well-known endpoint.

rules.title: SMART scope minimization
rules.description: Flags wildcard scopes advertised by the representative SMART configuration.
rules.remediation: Advertise and request only resource-specific scopes needed by the workflow.

rules.title: Evidence redaction
rules.description: Scans representative evidence for direct identifiers, tokens, and secrets.
rules.remediation: Redact direct identifiers and credentials before logs or evidence storage.

rules.title: HTTP security headers
rules.description: Verifies the synthetic target's recorded transport security header assertion.
rules.remediation: Set strict transport and content security headers at the public edge.

rules.title: Token claim constraints
rules.description: Verifies issuer, audience, expiry, and context assertions from synthetic tokens.
rules.remediation: Validate issuer, audience, expiry, signature, and patient context on every token.

rules.title: Audit correlation completeness
rules.description: Checks that synthetic access evidence has actor, action, target, and correlation.
rules.remediation: Record actor, action, target, outcome, timestamp, and trace correlation.

rules.title: Redirect allowlist enforcement
rules.description: Verifies that untrusted redirect destinations are rejected in the synthetic scenario.
rules.remediation: Match exact pre-registered redirect URIs and reject private or untrusted destinations.

rules.title: Patient context isolation
rules.description: Verifies that synthetic requests cannot retrieve resources outside the authorized patient context.
rules.remediation: Bind patient-scoped tokens to every query and enforce the context before resource access.

rules.title: Retention and export declaration
rules.description: Requires deterministic evidence declaring retention limits and supported data export behavior.
rules.remediation: Publish enforceable retention periods and a documented, auditable export process.
